text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Osaka Hai. Gold City can't 
get her head in the game, questioning 
whether it's right to run in such a 
halfhearted state.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was about to run without a goal. But, 
if she was going to run, she didn't want 
to look uncool... Still feeling 
conflicted, she headed to the race.
